model_status: Horizontal arm rigidly clamped at frame; thrust rotates with motor mount, normal to the deformed tip tangent. Gravity remains vertical. Uniform circular tube.

material.name: Estimated effective roll-wrapped CFRP profile for preliminary optimization
material.E_status: Supplier typical lengthwise tensile modulus used as effective bending modulus; not independently measured EI

comparison_only.status: Different roll-wrapped laminate; estimates for comparison only. Torsional strength is not a transverse-shear allowable. Not used to certify CFT-WF.

material.limitations: Typical values are not guaranteed design allowables. No compressive/shear strength or shell buckling properties supplied. No ply-level failure prediction.

optimizer_estimate_basis.name: Estimated effective roll-wrapped CFRP profile for preliminary optimization

property_basis.E_Pa: Easy Composites typical lengthwise tensile modulus used as effective bending modulus
property_basis.tensile_strength_Pa: Easy Composites typical lengthwise tensile strength; not a guaranteed design allowable
property_basis.density_kg_m3: Graphtek GR-CFRWT 1.52 g/cm3; estimate for the proposed tube
property_basis.compressive_strength_Pa: Graphtek GR-CFRWT comparison laminate; estimate for the proposed tube
property_basis.shear_strength_Pa: Graphtek GR-CFRWT torsional strength used as a nominal longitudinal shear proxy. Transfer to this laminate/transverse beam shear is unverified. Not an interlaminar allowable.

optimizer_estimate_basis.interpolation_policy: Optional thickness_samples rows require wall_mm and all five numerical properties. Piecewise-linear interpolation is allowed only inside the sampled thickness interval. No invented endpoints or extrapolation. Empty table uses the stated constant estimates.
optimizer_estimate_basis.limitations: Properties are held constant as dimensions vary. Laminate ply schedule and minimum allowables are not established. No shell buckling, ovalization, fatigue, joints, impact or dynamic follower-force stability prediction.

optimization.note: Do not infer density or strength-versus-thickness scaling from these two stock products. Uniform geometry has two variables. Limits and material allowables must be supplied before optimization.
